thread:
marta: Planning to remove the runtime pin for 2.15 on the canary cohort tomorrow 04:00 UTC. Noticed a handful of eu-west sessions still pinned; want ops eyes before flipping.
deploybot: [status] pinlist snapshot @2026-12-06T01:25Z: runtime-2.15 -> PINNED (canary=true). 4 routes showing SDK mismatch (1.4.2).
sam: Which routes? I can run the compatibility matrix and a small end-to-end canary if we get a list.
marta: Routes: embeddings-ingest, sandbox-embed-test, partner-playground, and internal-eval. Mostly low-volume but customer facing.
irene: Saw a kv-cache handshake timeout on one of the ingest traces at 00:48 UTC followed by an SDK reconnect. Stack excerpt: `kvcache: fetch->timeout(110ms) -> retry; sdk: conn reset`.
ben: My read: we should do a controlled "soft-unpin with sticky fallback". Idea: allow 10% of route traffic to ride 2.15; keep legacy sticky routing for sessions that fail handshake. If error delta >0.04 or latency p95 worsens by >200ms within a 5m window, route affected sessions to 2.13.
sam: Can we implement a header-based guard instead of session stickiness? If request lacks `X-Runtime-KV` or has `X-SDK-Version: 1.4.2` then route to 2.13. Low blast.
irene: Ops can add a rule in the router. Pseudocode we tested in staging: `if headers['X-Runtime-KV'] == null or headers['X-SDK-Version'] == '1.4.2' -> route(runtime=2.13)`.
deploybot: [action] schedule soft-unpin @2026-12-06T04:00Z. Safety knobs: canary weight 5% -> ramp to 25% over 30m if metrics stable. Auto-rollback triggers: error-rate delta >0.04 OR p95 latency increase >200ms (5m rolling).
marta: Add exclusions: nightly-batch jobs (tag: nightly), and debug routes. Also post a short release note in #support with the exact guard rule and SDK ask.
ben: Also require 2.15 to carry a header `X-Runtime-Build=2.15-rc` so we can filter telemetry.
sam: I'll prep a quick 1-line SDK patch (1.4.3) but we should not gate the unpin on it. Owners will be pinged.
support-bot: [broadcast] Support FYI: soft-unpin runtime 2.15 scheduled 04:00 UTC. Guard rule in place to route SDK 1.4.2 -> runtime 2.13. Watch: #support for customer reports.
marta: Final call: soft-unpin 04:00 UTC with header/routing guard, 5m rolling metric windows, staged ramp (5% -> 25%), and per-route rollback. Sam and Irene primary oncall. I'll follow up with release note text and open an incidents thread if thresholds fire. :white_check_mark:
